howto: Sixteen players drop in; you start in the middle with an M9 pistol.
Move, aim and shoot; walk over pick-ups to grab guns, ammo, bandages and medkits.
Shoot crates open for more loot.
Stay inside the circle: the red gas outside it hurts, and the circle closes in through six zones.
Be the last one standing to win.
tips: Swap the M9 early: crates often hold an MP5, M870 or AK-47.
Heal behind cover: a bandage (3) takes 2 s, a medkit (4) takes 4 s.
When a dashed white ring appears, that is the next circle: get inside it before the gas arrives.
Bushes hide you: bots do not spot you in one from far away.
Reload (R) between fights, not in the middle of one.

controls.keyboard: WASD to move, mouse to aim, left button to fire, R reload, 3 bandage, 4 medkit. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag on the left half to move, drag on the right half to aim and fire; RELOAD, BANDAGE and MEDKIT buttons on the right.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the menu set how well the 15 bots aim and how fast they open fire. Every match also tightens as the gas circle shrinks and hurts more in the last zones.

features.difficulty: Easy / Normal / Hard buttons on the menu (bot aim and reaction time)
features.power-up-list: LOOT GUIDE on the menu: every gun with damage, fire rate and magazine, plus ammo, bandage, medkit and crates
features.wave-or-level-counter: The HUD shows ZONE n/6 with the gas timer, and ALIVE players left
features.high-score-table: BEST MATCHES on the menu: your top five finishes by place, with kills, time and date, beside wins, kills and best place
features.results: ELIMINATED or VICTORY card with place, kills, damage and time survived, and Play again
features.tutorial: First match: four prompts (move, aim and fire, loot, stay in the circle), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint reads the gas, the next circle, your health, ammo and the nearest bot's direction
